summary.text: Mike Armanini is a Republican state representative who represents Pennsylvania House District 75, covering parts of Elk and Clearfield counties, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He spent more than 30 years in the powder metallurgy industry and was headmaster of DuBois Central Catholic School before running for office.

paragraphs.text: Armanini was born and raised in Kersey, Elk County, and graduated from Elk County Christian High School and Clarion University, according to his official biography.
Ballotpedia lists a B.S. in business administration from Clarion in 1985.

His career in powder metallurgy began in 1986 at Laurel Manufacturing in DuBois, and in 1997 he started Product Assurance Services in St. Marys, later co-founding Proform Powdered Metals in Punxsutawney.
Armanini serves on the House Energy; Liquor Control; Professional Licensure; and Tourism and Economic and Recreational Development committees.
He sits on the County National Bank Advisory Board and the Penn Highlands Community Nurses board of directors.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Kimberly Kohlhepp as his opponent in the general election.
